rows.note: Governor's budget voluntarily extends work requirements and 6-month redeterminations to certain state-funded immigrant enrollees. ~5M expansion enrollees potentially affected; ~63% of adults without dependent children already work 80+ hrs/month or attend school.
Enacted standards stricter than the federal minimum; April 2026 legislation appropriated $319M to close the FY2026 shortfall.
Re-implementing after the 2018 attempt that caused ~18,000 coverage losses before being halted by a federal court.
